_doc: Twenty-two quest frames — eighteen that bind to something particular, and four bread-and-butter ones at the top that bind to almost anything so a quiet farming zone still has a board. A frame is a template with typed slots; js/jobgen.js fills every slot from things that EXIST in the current territory right now and refuses to emit the frame if it cannot. That is the whole idea — a job is a fact about the world, phrased, not a coordinate rolled out of nothing. `scope` local means the pin is in the zone you are standing in; `adjacent` means a zone that touches it and the text says so; `rumour` never gets a pin at all. Placeholders are {slot.field}. A frame's `reward` may also name WHAT IT PAYS IN with `kind`: coin (money and experience), crate (a piece of gear through the loot popup), materials (a bag of stock — with `mats` to say exactly which, or `matPool` to name one of build/hunt/ruin), choice (the giver asks you which of those three you would rather have), or pick3 (three rare-or-better items, you take one). Say nothing and js/questrewards.js decides from the shape of the job. Every other key of `reward` is an EXTRA and is handed to a handler by name — perk, opens, reveals, brand.

frames.title: There are too many {beast.name} about
frames.text: There are more {beast.name} around {zone.name} than anyone can remember. Thin them out.

frames.title: Carry this to {there.name}
frames.text: A crate, a name, and a walk to {there.name}. Nobody will thank you but somebody will pay you.

frames.title: Bring back what they carry
frames.text: Somebody in {zone.name} wants what a {beast.name} carries, and is not saying why.

frames.title: Look in on {spot.name}
frames.text: Nobody has walked out to {spot.name} in a month. Go and see what is there now.

frames.title: {beast.name} has taken {site.name}
frames.text: Nobody has been up to {site.name} since {beast.name} moved in. Put it out.

onDone.rumour: the way up to {site.name} is walkable again

frames.title: {caravan.name} is overdue
frames.text: {caravan.name} should have been in two days ago. Walk the road and find out what happened to it.

frames.title: See {caravan.name} through
frames.text: {caravan.name} leaves within the hour and the road is not what it was. Walk with it.

frames.title: {patrol.name} has not reported
frames.text: {patrol.name} walked out past {site.name} and nobody has seen them since. Find them.

onDone.rumour: what is left of {patrol.name} is out past {site.name}

frames.title: {foe.name} is still out there
frames.text: {foe.name} beat you and has not stopped telling people. It knows where you sleep.

frames.title: Settle it at {gate.name}
frames.text: You walked past {gate.name} without paying. The Count remembers. Settle up, or take the long way for good.

frames.title: {town.name} is short
frames.text: {town.name} has been on half rations for a week. Bring what you can.

frames.title: The fallen stone at {stones.name}
frames.text: One of the stones at {stones.name} is down, and the ring has not sung since. Put it back.

onDone.rumour: the ring at {stones.name} is whole again

frames.title: {who.name}'s boy has not come back
frames.text: {who.name}'s boy went into {hole.name} three days ago on a dare. Bring him out, one way or the other.

onDone.rumour: {hole.name} has been walked, at least the first of it

frames.title: {relic.name} belongs to somebody
frames.text: {keeper.name} says {relic.name} came out of a grave and should go back in one. You could also sell it and say nothing.

frames.title: Break the hold on {zone.name}
frames.text: Three camps hold {zone.name}. Take all three and the ground changes hands.

onDone.rumour: {zone.name} does not belong to them any more

frames.title: Clear out {camp.name}
frames.text: {camp.name} went up last week and it is already three tents bigger. Burn it before it takes root.

frames.title: Light {beacon.name}
frames.text: There is a raid band on the road and nobody at the tower. Reach {beacon.name} before they reach the gate.

frames.title: Open {mine.name}
frames.text: {mine.name} came down years ago with most of a shift still in it. It is three days' digging, and you can do a day at a time.

onDone.rumour: {mine.name} is open again, and something is down there

frames.title: Put them back down
frames.text: Something got dug at {field.name} and the rest have taken it badly. Walk it after dark and finish them.

frames.title: Put {zone.name} on the chart
frames.text: Three places in {zone.name} nobody has written down. Stand at each and the Longsight will pay for the telling.

frames.title: {smith.name} wants a source
frames.text: {smith.name} will brand your weapon, but the fire has to come from somewhere. {beast.name} carries it.

frames.title: Word from {there.name}
frames.text: {there.name} is next door and it is having a bad week — {trouble.blurb}. It is a walk. Nobody will mind if you do not.
